notes: RDC-003: a src-domain flop drives the sync reset of a dst flop directly (mux-on-D spelling on the no-opt flow). The destination samples its reset on its own edge from a foreign source, which is the SRST analogue of an ARST crossing. CDC-001 fires beside it: the mux select reaches D through the gate, so the data path sees the same foreign source. RDC-009 stays silent by design: the destination's own async reset puts both sides in reset domains, but the foreign flop arrives only through the mux select, which is control rather than data.
